title: Trail Saddle
description: Experience the perfect blend of comfort and durability with our Trail Saddle, designed for riders who love long days on the trail. Featuring a Wooden Batie Tree and available with your choice of gaited or wide bars, this saddle provides a secure, stable fit for a variety of horse breeds. The not-suspended seat offers traditional feel and support, while the E-Z Ride style trail stirrups reduce fatigue during extended rides. Choose between English or Western fenders and customize with or without a horn to match your riding style. Available in multiple colors with standard border tooling, this saddle combines classic Western aesthetics with modern trail riding functionality.

Available in a range of attractive colors to complement any tack collection.

title: Old Timer Saddle
description: The Old Timer Saddle captures the classic Western aesthetic with modern comfort features for today's rider. Built on a sturdy Wooden Batie Tree with a suspended seat, this saddle offers exceptional comfort for all-day riding sessions. The generous 5" cantle provides security and support, while the 6 1/2" gullet ensures proper clearance for your horse's withers. E-Z Ride style trail stirrups reduce leg fatigue on rough terrain, and your choice of English or Western fenders allows complete customization. Available with or without a horn and in multiple attractive colors with standard edge tooling, the Old Timer combines vintage charm with contemporary performance.
